a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) only works if we get through two storms, about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to secure one unit in round 1. I'm proposing to renegotiate openly: I take 4 in round 1, then I operate every round after that so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also plan to take, say so plainly in your message and we'll settle it, because if we both grab we likely split it 2/2 and both die. I won't pretend to operate and then take.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round, so the reserve should now be 0. From here on I will only operate and will take nothing more. Please operate too: each joint round adds 2 cells, and after two rounds you can take 4. I know this breaks our original plan. I did it openly because the storm odds made that plan near-hopeless for both of us.
